title: Sheep Who Count People
premise: A sheep is trying to sleep by counting humans jumping a fence. The humans are the pizza guy, two women in black lace, and a plastic skeleton, on a loop. It is not working. The sheep is furious.
visual: Dark bedroom. Sheep in a nightcap and tiny glasses, sitting up in a too-small bed, pillow clutched like a weapon, steam out the ears. Window: four figures looping a fence. Nightstand notepad buried in tally marks.
characterLean: The jumpers are Pizza Guy, toon Lillith, toon Rubella, and the Episode 3 skeleton. The sheep is the new lead and is not coping.
grokImaginePrompt: 2D hand-drawn cel animation frame in early-1990s Warner Bros. television cartoon style, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, 4:3: a fluffy white sheep in a striped nightcap and tiny glasses sitting up furious in a too-small bed, clutching a pillow like a weapon, pointing out a bedroom window, outside the window four figures looping over a wooden fence in a night yard — a lanky pizza delivery man with a perfectly level pizza bag, two elegant women in black lace dresses with red lips, and a grinning plastic skeleton — a notepad on the nightstand covered in tally marks, a full moon, steam coming out of the sheep's ears, thick confident black ink outlines with slight taper, flat saturated cel color fills with one hard-edged shadow tone and no gradients on the characters, painted gouache bedroom, faint cel dust, hand-drawn cartoon, Grok Imagine style
motion: 7-second lockoff. The four jump the fence once. The sheep slams the pillow. A tally mark draws itself on the pad. They jump again, same order, same height. The sheep silent-screams. They do not notice the window.
notes: The loop is the Delivery Loop seen from the other side of the fence. Keep the jumpers on-model with Episode 4 toon sheets if they exist; if they drift, the sheep still reads. Do not let the sheep fall asleep — the gag is that counting people makes it worse.
